title: Night vision and nighttime lighting
summary: Feedback on this topic centers on appreciation for nighttime lighting and prior night-vision features, alongside a request for night-vision assistance in low-light driving, while many fragments only mention darkness or night conditions without a clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car’s nighttime appearance, interior or exterior lighting touches, and the usefulness of prior night-vision capability for spotting people or animals in the dark.

negative.summary: Negative feedback asks for a night-vision system to help with low-light visibility and hazard warnings while driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention night, darkness, or interest in night vision without enough context to tell whether the customer is praising or criticizing the vehicle.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are too brief or contextual to determine sentiment clearly.
This topic mixes at least two related but distinct subjects: requests for a night-vision feature and general comments about nighttime appearance or dark conditions.
Examples are limited, so the summary should not be treated as representative beyond these sampled fragments.
